messages:
emily-support: Hey team — ACME reached out asking for evidence we removed their EU data and also asking for 'HSM key destruction proof'. They're on hosted EU cluster. Ticket 84217.
sam-security: Do we know if they used customer-managed keys or our managed KMS? That changes what we can provide.
emily-support: Their msg says 'HSM-backed keys' in the contract but support record shows default Redwood-managed KMS for that org.
luca-privacy: If keys are Redwood-managed, we cannot destroy customer-side keys on a customer request; we can provide CloudTrail/KMS audit events showing DisableKey/DeleteAlias/RotateKey actions and roster of sub-processors (HSM provider).
maria-legal: Agreed. Offerable artifacts: 1) KMS event export covering the key ARN/time range; 2) signed attestation that Redwood did not perform customer-side HSM private key export; 3) subprocessor list + contract dates. If they insist on destruction proof, we need to confirm they actually had customer-managed HSM.
audit-bot: export job started — job_id=job-cc7a, range=2024-11-01..2025-03-01, sources=[cloudtrail,kms-logs,console-audit]
ops-jen: Where should I drop the zipped evidence when ready? Customer wants S3 transfer with signed URL; legal ok with that?
maria-legal: S3 signed URL OK if transfer is encrypted and we record delivery. Use retention tag 'dpa-evidence' and set TTL 90d.
emily-support: I'll ask ACME to confirm whether they had a customer-managed HSM or were using our managed keys. Also asked if they need the audit export only or a formal attestation.
customer-success-josh: Heads-up — ACME is sensitive about residency. They might escalate to SOC contact if we can't show key lifecycle at region level (eu-west-1). Keep region scoped in outputs.
sam-security: For ledgers, I'll produce a minimal reproducible query snippet for the KMS events:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234
``` 
and collect events with EventName in ["ScheduleKeyDeletion","DisableKey","CreateKey","DisableKeyRotation"].
luca-privacy: Also include the subprocessor snapshot (date-stamped). I'll attach our current HSM vendor list and contract start/stop dates once audit job finishes.
emily-support: Perfect. If they confirm they had a private HSM, we will need the ops runbook for key handoff — pinging @ops-jen to standby.
ops-jen: On it. If it's private HSM, we will need customer-signed nonce + key handle to verify destruction; that'll be a coordination with infra team.
maria-legal: One more: prepare a short cover note explaining what evidence means (logs vs. physical HSM tamper proof). Avoid language that implies we destroy customer keys unless documented.
emily-support: Thanks — I'll send ACME a checklist: 1) confirm key type (managed vs customer), 2) whether they want export vs attestation, 3) delivery preference (signed URL or upload). Will update thread.
